graph.hint: Click a node to see its reasoning and provenance. Click a legend chip to hide a kind of node or edge.

home.title: Answer → triples → a score you can audit
home.lead: Every answer becomes an RDF graph. The lecturer's key, the OWL ontology, the SWRL rules and SPARQL are visible at every step, and the score is recomputed from the stored graph.

jawaban.title: Answer
jawaban.missing: Open this page from an answer: its address needs ?run= and ?answer=.
jawaban.check: Python score {python} · SPARQL recompute from the triple store {sparql}
jawaban.check_graphs: This query runs over the named graphs:
jawaban.ledger: System ledger (one ag:LedgerEntry per reference triple)
jawaban.feedback_llm: Written by the LLM from the ledger.
jawaban.sentences: Answer sentences (the PROV-O source of each triple)
jawaban.alignment_help: Left: student triples ([concept] from the alias table, [?] by embedding). Right: reference triples coloured by status. Thick arrows: ledger evidence; red: ag:contradicts from SWRL; dotted: aligned but another predicate. Read from
jawaban.step_sigma: 2 · σ = min(subject sim, object sim) per pair
jawaban.step_aligned: 3 · Facts Python asserts for Pellet (σ ≥ τh): {n} pairs
jawaban.step_contradictions: 4 · Inferred by Pellet with the SWRL rules: {n} ag:contradicts
jawaban.no_contradictions: No contradiction. Reference triples not mentioned stay Missing (open-world assumption).
jawaban.no_aligned: No aligned pairs, so Pellet has no input for the contradiction rules.
jawaban.rdf_help: This answer's named graphs in the Oxigraph triple store.

review.title: Review this answer
review.help: Change a status where the system is wrong and give a reason; the score is recomputed (Eq. 6) and checked with SPARQL.
review.none_left: No other answers are waiting for review.
review.stale: The question's key changed after grading. Grade it again before reviewing.

sparql.over_graphs: Read-only, over the ontology and the named graphs:
sparql.over_store: Read-only, over the whole triple store; the default graph is the union of all named graphs (use GRAPH ?g to see where a triple comes from).

penilaian.title: Assessment
penilaian.missing: Open this page from an assessment on the Classes page.
penilaian.synthetic: Contains synthetic answers (demo data), not real student answers.
penilaian.no_answers: No answers for this assessment yet. Import them on the Classes page.
penilaian.grading_help: Runs on the server: you can close the page. Annotated answers use their annotation; the rest are extracted by the LLM (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
penilaian.llm_feedback: Feedback from the LLM (needs an API key)
penilaian.job_interrupted: Interrupted because the server stopped. Click again to carry on.
penilaian.review_help: Approve at once the graded answers with no ⚑ and no contradiction. Open the others one by one from the table.
penilaian.approve: Approve {n} answers with no ⚑ and no contradiction
penilaian.mean_note: The mean covers every question of the assessment; an unanswered question counts as 0.
